population._comment: Population counts from census home location data (home_locs_dict). Summed from all census blocks within configured counties.
population.total_population_comment: Sum of total_employees + total_non_employees across all home blocks
population.total_employees_comment: Sum of n_employees field from each home block (workers who commute)
population.total_non_employees_comment: Sum of non_employees field from each home block (non-workers: retirees, students, etc.)

unscaled_trips._comment: Total trips BEFORE applying scaling_factor. Represents full population trip demand.
unscaled_trips.work_comment: Unscaled work trips = total_employees (one work trip per employee)
unscaled_trips.nonwork_comment: Sum of unscaled trips across all enabled nonwork purposes. Each purpose: non_employees * trip_rate from survey data

plans_comment._comment: Plan counts AFTER applying scaling_factor. plans = unscaled_trips * scaling_factor
plans_comment.work: Number of work plans generated (employees * scaling_factor)
plans_comment.shopping: Number of shopping plans (non_employees * shopping_trip_rate * scaling_factor)
plans_comment.school: Number of school plans (non_employees * school_trip_rate * scaling_factor)
plans_comment.socialrecreation: Number of social/recreation plans (non_employees * rate * scaling_factor)
plans_comment.dining: Number of dining plans (non_employees * dining_trip_rate * scaling_factor)
plans_comment.other: Number of other purpose plans (non_employees * other_trip_rate * scaling_factor)
plans_comment.total: Sum of all plan counts across all purposes (work + all nonwork)
plans_comment.success_rate: Percentage of successfully generated plans: (total / (total + failed)) * 100
plans_comment.chain_retries: Total retries due to invalid activity chains (sum of all reasons below)
plans_comment.chain_retries_too_short: Retries due to chain having fewer than 3 activities
plans_comment.chain_retries_bad_structure: Retries due to chain not starting/ending with Home
plans_comment.chain_retries_missing_purpose: Retries due to chain missing target nonwork purpose
plans_comment.chain_retries_missing_work: Retries due to chain missing Work activity (work plans)
plans_comment.chain_retries_has_work: Retries due to chain containing Work (nonwork plans)
plans_comment.chain_retries_too_many_work: Retries due to chain exceeding max Work activities
plans_comment.poi_retries: Total retries due to POI selection failures (no suitable POI found nearby)
plans_comment.time_retries: Total retries due to time constraint violations (activities overlapping or out of bounds)

parameters._comment: Key simulation parameters from config file
parameters.scaling_factor_comment: Fraction of full population to simulate. E.g., 0.1 means 10% sample. From config.plan_generation.scaling_factor
parameters.iterations_comment: Number of MATSim iterations for route/plan optimization. From config.matsim.configurable_params.lastIteration
parameters.flow_capacity_factor_comment: MATSim QSim flow capacity scaling. Should roughly match scaling_factor. Controls how many vehicles can pass a link per time unit.
parameters.storage_capacity_factor_comment: MATSim QSim storage capacity scaling. Should be >= flow_capacity_factor. Controls how many vehicles can be on a link simultaneously.
parameters.modes_comment: Snapshot of config.modes.{bus,rail}.{config_rate,blend_weight} used for this run. Demand estimator reads this together with mode_choice.mode_distribution to back-calculate empirical chain_reduction for the next run.

mode_choice._comment: Mode-choice outputs aggregated across all purposes (trip-weighted). Used by the demand estimator to derive empirical chain_reduction.
mode_choice.mode_distribution_comment: Share of legs assigned to each mode across all generated plans, weighted by purpose volume.

data_quality._comment: Metrics about input data quality and coverage
data_quality.home_blocks_comment: Number of census blocks in home_locs_dict (filtered by configured counties)
data_quality.home_blocks_with_coords_comment: Census blocks that have valid lat/lon coordinates (should equal home_blocks)
data_quality.total_pois_comment: Total POIs loaded from database and filtered to county bounding box + 5km buffer
data_quality.poi_activity_types_comment: Number of distinct activity types in POI data (e.g., Shopping, School, Dining)

network.num_nodes_comment: Number of network nodes (intersections). Parsed from <nodes> element in network.xml
network.num_links_comment: Number of network links (road segments). Parsed from <links> element in network.xml
network.file_size_mb_comment: Size of network.xml file in megabytes

plans_file_size_mb_comment: Size of plans.xml file in megabytes. Larger files = more agents simulated.

runtime.total_min_comment: Total experiment runtime from start to finish (includes all steps)
runtime.plans_min_comment: Time spent generating activity plans (work + all nonwork purposes)
runtime.matsim_min_comment: Time spent running MATSim simulation (all iterations)
runtime.eval_min_comment: Time spent on evaluation (comparing sim output to ground truth)

paths._comment: Relative paths to experiment outputs (from experiment directory)
paths.output_comment: MATSim simulation output directory (contains ITERS/, linkstats, etc.)
paths.evaluation_comment: Evaluation results directory (comparison CSVs, plots, maps)

simulation_status_comment: Final status: completed, failed, or skipped

generated_plans_modes._comment: Generated-leg counts by mode, parsed from plans.xml. These are the demand-side shares produced by ModeChoiceModel BEFORE MATSim replanning. For realised post-simulation shares see matsim_output (output_legs_count, transit.pt_legs_total).
generated_plans_modes.counts_comment: Number of legs per mode summed across all generated plans
generated_plans_modes.shares_pct_comment: Mode shares as percentages of total legs. Sums to ~100.
generated_plans_modes.total_legs_comment: Total legs across all generated plans (all purposes)

matsim_output._comment: Statistics extracted from MATSim output files (scorestats.csv, traveldistancestats.csv, legHistogram.txt, etc.)
matsim_output.output_persons_count_comment: Number of persons (agents) in final output. From output_persons.csv.gz.
matsim_output.output_executed_plans_count_comment: Number of executed plans (selected="yes") in final iteration. This equals the number of persons - one executed plan per person.
matsim_output.output_total_plans_count_comment: Total plans in output_plans.xml.gz including non-selected alternatives. MATSim keeps multiple plans per person for learning/replanning.
matsim_output.output_trips_count_comment: Total trips completed in simulation. From output_trips.csv.gz.
matsim_output.output_legs_count_comment: Total legs (mode segments) in simulation. From output_legs.csv.gz.
matsim_output.score_final_executed_comment: Average executed plan score in final iteration. Higher = better agent utility.
matsim_output.score_final_best_comment: Average best plan score per agent in final iteration.
matsim_output.score_improvement_comment: Score improvement from iteration 0 to final iteration. Positive = agents found better routes.
matsim_output.avg_leg_distance_km_comment: Average distance per leg (single mode segment) in kilometers.
matsim_output.avg_trip_distance_km_comment: Average distance per trip (origin to destination) in kilometers.
matsim_output.avg_leg_duration_min_comment: Average travel time per leg in minutes. From legdurations.txt.
matsim_output.total_person_km_comment: Total person-kilometers traveled by all agents. From pkm_modestats.csv.
matsim_output.total_person_hours_traveling_comment: Total person-hours spent traveling. From ph_modestats.csv. (Excludes wait time; sum of *_travel columns only.)
matsim_output.peak_departures_per_5min_comment: Maximum departures in any 5-minute interval. Indicates peak demand.
matsim_output.peak_hour_comment: Time of day with highest departure rate (HH:MM:SS format).
matsim_output.max_en_route_comment: Maximum number of agents traveling simultaneously. Indicates network load.
matsim_output.total_stuck_agents_comment: Count of stuckAndAbort events from the final-iteration events file (authoritative). Each event = one agent giving up on a leg. Counted on the simulated sample (multiply by 1/scaling_factor for population-equivalent). Should be near 0 for good simulations.
matsim_output.final_iteration_comment: Last completed iteration number. Should match config iterations setting.
matsim_output.transit_comment: Public-transit sub-mode breakdown. Per-submode counts of routes and departures (from transitSchedule.xml), vehicles (from transitVehicles.xml), and realised pt legs (from output_legs.csv.gz, grouped by vehicle_id suffix). MATSim collapses all transit to mode="pt" in plans/legs, so the suffix is the only signal that distinguishes bus / rail / tram / subway / etc. submodes_with_supply_but_no_demand flags the canonical "routes dropped during pt2matsim mapping" regression — e.g. tram vehicles defined but zero tram legs.

evaluation._comment: Comparison of simulated traffic volumes vs ground truth traffic counts. Metrics calculated from hourly volume comparisons at matched device locations.
evaluation.num_devices_comment: Number of ground truth traffic count devices successfully matched to network links
evaluation.num_comparisons_comment: Total hourly comparison points (num_devices * hours with valid data)
evaluation.geh_lt_5_pct_comment: Percentage of comparisons with GEH < 5 (industry standard for "good" match). Target: >85% for calibrated models. GEH formula: sqrt(2*(sim-obs)^2/(sim+obs))
evaluation.correlation_comment: Pearson correlation coefficient between simulated and observed volumes. Range: -1 to 1. Values > 0.7 indicate strong positive correlation.
evaluation.mean_geh_comment: Average GEH across all comparisons. Lower is better. GEH < 5 is considered acceptable for individual comparisons.
evaluation.mae_comment: Mean Absolute Error in vehicles/hour. Average |simulated - observed| across all comparisons.
evaluation.rmse_comment: Root Mean Square Error in vehicles/hour. Penalizes large errors more than MAE. RMSE = sqrt(mean((simulated - observed)^2))
evaluation.mean_pct_error_comment: Mean percentage error: mean((simulated - observed) / observed * 100). Negative = underestimating traffic, Positive = overestimating traffic. Sensitive to boundary stations with through-traffic from outside the modeled area; prefer interquartile_mean_ratio for calibration decisions.
evaluation.interquartile_mean_ratio_comment: Interquartile mean of per-station sim/obs total-volume ratios. Drops bottom & top 25% of stations and averages the middle 50%. Robust to boundary stations; 1.0 = perfect, <0.7 = under-simulation. Used as the primary signal for demand_estimator scaling-factor decisions.
evaluation.median_station_ratio_comment: Median of per-station sim/obs ratios. Companion to interquartile_mean_ratio.
evaluation.pct_stations_below_10pct_comment: Percent of count stations whose simulated total is below 10% of observed. High values indicate boundary stations capturing through-traffic from outside the modeled region (cannot be fixed by raising demand).
